name: shared-pad-bus
description: Driver, both single-ended receivers, the differential receiver and the D+ pull-up on one shared DP/DM pad pair while bus ownership changes: host J/K/SE0 with TXOE=0, device J/K/SE0 with TXOE=1, ownership returned to the host, an enabled-vs-host contention control and a PU_EN=0 disabled-driver pad-current cross-check with the receivers attached. Engineering data -- no numeric limit is adopted.
claim: Integration evidence, not a spec row: spec/decisions/0004-digital-analog-pin-contract.md defines the shared DP/DM pad nets and TXOE; this record reports pad voltages, receiver output levels and pad-crossing-to-output delays on those shared nets, and attaches NO numeric limit. The only checks are a functional-polarity count (receiver outputs on the expected side of VDD/2 while the host or device drives J/K/SE0; a smoke check, not a USB threshold) and a harness-integrity check that the deliberate enabled-vs-host contention is visible to the current meter. Pending DR-0004 rulings (spec section 6 high-Z/leakage row; RXD not consumed by the digital side) are NOT settled here, and no claim of complete USB or digital-timing compliance is made.

polarity_errors.description: functional smoke check, NOT a spec limit: counts receiver outputs (RXDP, RXDM, RXD) that sit on the wrong side of VDD/2 in the settled tail of a host- or device-driven J/K/SE0 state (RXD is not checked in SE0). Zero means every driven state reached the receivers with the intended polarity.

contention_dp_ua.description: harness integrity, NOT a spec row: with the device deliberately enabled (TXOE=1, J) against the host driving K the host-side pad current must exceed 1 mA, otherwise the meter could not see a fight and the ownership results prove nothing. The 1 mA floor is the same arbitrary detection margin driver-disabled-leakage uses, not a USB number.

contention_dm_ua.description: harness integrity, NOT a spec row: same detection control for DM.
